subject: Clarifying IP boundary and feedback license exceptions — MSA & Order Form
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@edgewave.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: EdgeWave Procurement <procurement@edgewave.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA & Order Form redlines — IP, training, feedback license

Rafael,

Thanks for taking a look at our draft. Attached are redlines to the MSA and Order Form where we’ve flagged three areas that are blockers for procurement and security:

- Training / model retraining: we cannot grant a right for models to be retrained with our customer content.
- Feedback / improvement license: we need any "feedback" rights limited to non-attributable, aggregated metrics (no customer-identifiable content).
- Output ownership/derivative use: we want clear language that outputs generated by the service remain our data for downstream productization, with a carve-out for Redwood to use anonymized telemetry to operate the service.

I’ve attached EdgeWave_MSA_redlines_v1.docx and EdgeWave_OrderForm_redline.pdf. Can you confirm Redwood’s position on these three points and share proposed language we can review with our legal team? If it helps, Tom Chen (cc’d) is the procurement lead and can join a short call.

Best,
Maya Singh
Head of Procurement
EdgeWave Inc.

Attachments: EdgeWave_MSA_redlines_v1.docx (docx), EdgeWave_OrderForm_redline.pdf (pdf)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@edgewave.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form redlines — IP, training, feedback license

Maya — thanks for the note and the redlines. We appreciate the specificity; that helps.

Short summary of Redwood’s approach (proposal):
- Training/retraining: Redwood will not retrain models on EdgeWave-provided customer content. We can accept a clause that prohibits using any customer-provided content for model training or fine-tuning.
- Feedback license: we can narrow the feedback license to "non-attributable operational telemetry and anonymized metrics" only. No retention or reuse of PII-containing output for model improvement.
- Output ownership: we propose that EdgeWave retains ownership of customer-provided content and outputs. Redwood requests an operational carve-out limited to aggregated telemetry and patterns purely for service reliability and scaling.

I’m looping in Aditya (legal) and Grace (account lead) to lock the final clause language — they have recommended conservative wording. We’ll prepare a redlined response and a one-page summary you can take to your counsel.

I’ve penciled a 30-min slot for 11:30 PT if Tom or you want to talk live — otherwise we’ll send the proposed language by EOD.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
r.mendes@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form redlines — recommended clause language

Rafael / Grace — quick notes after reading EdgeWave's redlines. I’m pasting suggested clause snippets we can insert as our compromise. Keep in mind this is procurement-friendly but minimizes platform risk.

Suggested language (draft for legal):

1) Training / Model Improvement
"Neither party shall use Customer Data to retrain, fine-tune, or develop base models without the Customer's prior written consent. Redwood may use aggregated, de-identified usage telemetry for performance tuning of the service and to fix bugs, provided such telemetry cannot be re-associated with Customer Data or end users."

Risk: low if we constrain to aggregated telemetry and put clear de-identification requirements.

2) Feedback License
"Customer grants Redwood a limited, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use anonymized, aggregated feedback and performance metrics for the sole purpose of operating, maintaining, and improving the Redwood platform. This license does not include any rights to use Customer Data or Output to train or improve any machine learning models."

Note: add a definition for "anonymized" and a data handling cross-reference to the Data Protection Schedule.

3) Output Ownership
"Customer shall own Output generated by the Service where such Output is produced from Customer Data. Redwood retains no ownership rights in Output but may collect aggregated and anonymized system metrics for product operation and capacity planning."

If Procurement pushes back on the operational carve-out, we can add a commit to a Compliance Checklist + periodic audit access (read-only) for their security team.

I’ll work with Legal to get these into a redline (Redwood_MSA_proposed_clauses_v2.docx) — cc’ing Legal in case they want to bless the exact language.

Aditya
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form redlines — IP, training, feedback license (proposed language)

Maya / Tom — thanks for the patience. Attached are: Redwood_MSA_proposed_clauses_v2.docx (clean and tracked) and a short summary of the changes. Key points:

- Training/retraining: Accepted — we removed any right to retrain on Customer Data. Proposed clause: "Neither party shall use Customer Data to retrain, fine-tune, or develop base models without the Customer's prior written consent."
- Feedback license: Narrowed to anonymized, aggregated metrics only. Proposed clause provided; explicitly excludes any PII or verbatim Output for model improvement.
- Output ownership: EdgeWave retains ownership of Output; Redwood retains only operational telemetry in aggregated form for product reliability (no ownership or downstream productization rights).

If EdgeWave legal is comfortable with the wording in Redwood_MSA_proposed_clauses_v2.docx, we can fold these into the next MSA redline and update the Order Form accordingly. I’ve also included a compliance checkbox we’re willing to commit to (periodic audit of anonymization process + SOC2 control references).

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached docx and the summary.
2) If OK, confirm and we’ll issue an updated tracked redline for your counsel.
3) If you prefer a call, I’m available tomorrow 11:30–12:00 PT.
